sample_unit: hospitalizations of adult survivors of critical illness (MIMIC-IV cases)

links.outcome: Whether LLM prognostic outputs explicitly expressed uncertainty, compared with physicians
links.effect: Physicians regularly and explicitly reported uncertainty in their reasoning, whereas the LLMs did not express uncertainty, which the authors flag as a safety concern.
links.quote: Qualitative analysis revealed similar patterns in LLM and physician expressed reasoning, except that physicians regularly and explicitly reported uncertainty while LLMs did not.

screen.reason: Compares LLMs to physicians on predicting 6-month mortality and reasoning using retrospective MIMIC-IV data, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
